forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send a link for you to create a new password.

forgotPassword.heroTitle: Get back in control of your routine.

forgotPassword.footer: Recover your access and return to your personal panel.

updatePassword.title: Create new password
updatePassword.description: Enter your new password to recover access to WstSide.
updatePassword.passwordMin: The new password must have at least 6 characters.
updatePassword.passwordMismatch: Passwords do not match. Check and try again.
updatePassword.genericError: We couldn't update your password. Request a new recovery link and try again.
updatePassword.securityTipDescription: Use a password with letters, numbers and symbols. Avoid reusing passwords from other services.
updatePassword.heroDescription: Create a new password to return to your personal system for finances, routine, goals and progress.
updatePassword.footer: Set a secure new password to continue using your panel.
updatePassword.protectionDescription: Use a strong password that is different from your old passwords.
